narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On August 14, 2024, Agents [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] and [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject during a consensual interview at a restaurant in Ann Arbor, Michigan, where the owner had reported an employee using another person's Social Security number.
The subject stated that he is a citizen of Mexico and presented a Mexican passport issued in 2018.
ENTRY:
The subject stated that he first entered the United States illegally near Calexico, California, in 2005 and lived in Fresno until he went back to Mexico in 2012.
On 07/09/2019 he flew from Guadalajara to Houston, presented his passport and a valid B1/B2 visa, and was admitted as a visitor until 01/08/2020. He has not left the United States since that entry.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
Notice to Appear.
